Subject: Re: Contract Questions

Hi Eliana,

Thank you for reviewing the contract. I appreciate you bringing these points up.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. Let’s discuss this further to see if we can reach a middle ground that works for both of us. Similarly, I am open to reviewing the non-compete clause to ensure it is equitable and reasonable. Please let me know when you are available for a brief call to discuss these adjustments.

On a separate note, you asked about the animals in which pearls are typically found. Pearls are primarily found in mollusks, specifically oysters and mussels.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
